top8.title: Never print secrets into logs or responses
Never commit secrets or local environment files

Never send notifications or emails from tests without sandboxing

Keep Git hooks as minimum quality gates, not full verification substitutes
Hook failure triage before push
Verify before committing despite commit hooks
Never truncate tables without explicit approval and backup

Run existing smoke tests after adding a new E2E harness
